title: Unrestricted file upload through raw move_uploaded_file()
root_cause: The upload bypasses the File Abstraction Layer and is moved with move_uploaded_file(). TYPO3's fileDenyPattern, MIME-type validation, storage permissions and file name sanitation never run, so an executable file can be written into a web-reachable directory.

origin.note: No advisory in the local knowledge store maps to this rule. This pair documents the contract of InsecureFileOperationRule.
